# ATMO

> > ATMO provides wearable and stationary air quality monitoring devices for personal health, workplace wellness, building certification, and scientific research.

ATMO offers hyperlocal air quality tracking through portable wearables (Atmotube PRO 2) and indoor monitoring solutions (Atmocube) with advanced multi-sensor technology. The platform serves individuals, enterprises, HVAC professionals, researchers, and building managers seeking real-time air pollution and indoor environmental quality data.

## Key Topics

- Atmotube PRO 2
- Atmocube
- Air Quality Monitoring
- Indoor Air Quality (IAQ)
- Particulate Matter (PM2.5, PM10, PM1)
- VOC/TVOC Measurements
- Wearable Air Quality Tracker

- Smart Indoor Air Monitor
- Health & Wellness
- LEED & WELL Certification
- Bluetooth API

- Workplace Air Quality

## Products

- [Atmotube PRO 2 – Hyperlocal Air Quality Tracker](https://atmotube.com/atmotube-pro): Portable wearable device for personal air quality monitoring with hyperlocal pollution detection
- [Atmocube — Smart Indoor Air Quality Monitor](https://atmotube.com/atmocube): 12-sensor indoor air quality monitor for residential and commercial spaces
- [Atmotube PRO 2 — Portable Air Quality Tracker (EU Store)](https://eu.store.atmotube.com/products/atmotube-pro-2): Atmotube PRO 2 product specifications and purchase options
- [Atmocube — Smart Indoor Air Quality Monitor (EU Store)](https://eu.store.atmotube.com/products/atmocube): Atmocube product features, sensors, and purchase options
- [ATMO Store](https://eu.store.atmotube.com): EU store for Atmotube and Atmocube product lineup with pricing

## Solutions & Use Cases

- [Atmocube for Healthy Buildings](https://atmotube.com/healthybuildings): Indoor air quality monitoring for LEED v5 and WELL building certification compliance
- [Solution for Workspace Managers](https://atmotube.com/solution-for-workspace-managers): Atmocube workplace solution for office air quality and employee wellness
- [Solution for HVAC Professionals](https://atmotube.com/solution-for-hvac-professionals): Air quality testing tools for HVAC professionals and healthy home inspections
- [Solution for Air Purifiers](https://atmotube.com/solution-for-air-purifiers): Atmocube integration for air purifier optimization and efficiency management
- [Air Quality and Wildfires](https://atmotube.com/air-quality-and-wildfires): Atmotube PRO 2 application for wildfire smoke and air quality monitoring

## Research & Education

- [Research Projects on Air Quality and Air Pollution](https://atmotube.com/researchers): ATMO products supporting 100+ scientific research projects worldwide
- [Understanding Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) and TVOC Measurements](https://atmotube.com/blog/understanding-vocs-and-tvoc-measurements): Guide explaining VOCs, TVOC sensors, and VOC Index for air quality assessment
- [What is Particulate Matter? Types of Particulate Matter](https://atmotube.com/blog/what-are-the-pms): Educational article on PM10, PM2.5, PM1 health impacts and pollution sources
- [Mobile Air Quality Monitoring Research Interview](https://atmotube.com/blog/mobile-air-quality-monitoring-research-and-its-real-life-impact-interview-with-dr-nimish-biloria-uts-and-dr-hamish-robertson-qut): Interview with researchers on mobile air quality monitoring and real-world applications
